description: Evidence manifest for proving a provider ingestion plan executed against the live platform database through the PostgreSQL writer adapter.
rules: plan_sha256 must be 64 lowercase hex characters
executed and transaction_committed must be true
attempted_steps and applied_steps must be positive after execution
applied_steps must match executed steps length
errors must be empty and represent only the final blocking execution failure
retry_errors must be a list and may contain prior transient attempt failures after a final committed transaction
steps must be in strictly increasing order
target_table values must be part of provider_ingestion_plan table_order
idempotency_key must be present for every step
notes: The validator checks captured ingestion execution metadata only. The companion CLI execute runner may connect to PostgreSQL through an explicit DSN and writes this manifest after the existing ingestion worker commits.
